project_overview.name: Unified Personal Finance Dashboard
project_overview.vibe: Extremely modern, clean, minimalist, fluid, authoritative
project_overview.target_audience: Users wanting strict control over budget, credit cards, and 50/30/20 rule tracking

anti_patterns: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Never use center alignment for dense data or paragraphs.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: High Density Grid (For Dashboards). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.card_style: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders (border-slate-800), rounded-md or rounded-lg maximum. NO heavy drop shadows.
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Left sidebar (w-64) for desktop, fixed. Hidden on mobile with hamburger menu opening a drawer.
spacing_and_layout.page_container: ml-0 md:ml-64 p-4 md:p-8 pt-20 md:pt-8 min-h-screen
spacing_and_layout.glassmorphism: Used strictly for fixed headers/navs: bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-800.

components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn UI Inputs, Select, Checkbox. Dark mode styling: bg-slate-900 border-slate-700 text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500.
components_strategy.tables: Dense rows. border-b border-slate-800. Hover effect on rows: hover:bg-slate-800/50. Align numbers to the right.
components_strategy.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Subtle transition-all duration-200. Focus rings must be cyan-700.
components_strategy.charts: Use Recharts. Tooltips MUST have bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-slate-200 to be readable.
components_strategy.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. Overlay must be bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm. Content bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactive elements must change state. Cards translate-y-[-2px] with slight border color change.

screens_and_routing.DashboardMensal (/): Default home. Top month selector. Cards for Total Income, Expenses, Balance. 50/30/20 Table. Emergency Fund Card. 3 Charts (Income vs Expense Bar, Category Doughnut, Payment Method Column).
screens_and_routing.Lancamentos (/lancamentos): Unified table for daily transactions. Quick Launch form. Card Registration form. Installment Simulator form.
screens_and_routing.Cartoes (/cartoes): Credit Card Dashboard. Month selector. Table of Invoices (Total Limit, Consumed, Available). Doughnut chart of consumption per card. Bar chart of Limit vs Invoice.
screens_and_routing.VisaoAnual (/anual): 12-month matrix table (Categories x Months). Line chart for Cashflow. Combo chart (Bar+Line) for Essential Cost vs Annual Average.

business_logic_rules.invoice_closing: If Purchase Date <= Closing Date: bill in current month. If > Closing Date: bill in next month.
business_logic_rules.essential_cost: Sum of expenses classified as 'Fixo' or 'Variável'.
business_logic_rules.emergency_fund: CLT = 6x Essential Cost. Autônomo = 12x Essential Cost.
business_logic_rules.rule_50_30_20: Needs (Fixo/Variável) <= 50%. Wants (Extra/Adicional) <= 30%. Savings (Income - Expenses) >= 20%. Mark as '✅ Saudável' or '❌ Acima/Abaixo'.

technical_instructions.frameworks: React (using .js/.jsx, NOT .tsx), Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Recharts.
technical_instructions.data_persistence: Must use localStorage. Initialize with 5 mock transactions and 1 active installment.
technical_instructions.export: Include a button to export transaction data as CSV.
technical_instructions.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-transaction-btn').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Write code in .js / .jsx files. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use solid or heavily blurred backgrounds.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add text-align: center to the root.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Ensure charts use color-blind-friendly palettes (use the Slate and Cyan variations appropriately).
